decisions: Supersede one-pending UI admission with bounded application-wide FIFO admission: at most 2 executing saves and 22 total admitted requests including capture preparation and waiting. With 2 executing, 20 more may wait. Native media buttons and the explicit chooser use the same FIFO. Repeated identical pending actions reuse their state instead of submitting duplicates; equivalent cross-pane requests are rejected with an explicit existing-work explanation.

Freeze and validate selected content at request time, release temporary draft after owning the snapshot, never recapture a different page after waiting. Pending work participates in graceful shutdown/update/cancel and account epoch invalidation. No automatic resend after uncertain acknowledgement.
Keep provenance, allowed resource URLs, exact selectors, bounded requests, receipt tombstones, sequence validation, file integrity and publication verification intact.

Displayed total/processed media counts cover image/video/unavailable image/video only. Avatar/poster remain saved as contextual assets but do not inflate visible media count. HLS graph is one video, not many files. Processed is not a success assertion.

Retain cumulative downloadedBytes semantics as actual received bytes. Add current transfer received/total bytes when known, separately from unknown whole-job total. No guessed HLS size, no extra HEAD or speculative URL requests. Show current-file ratio when known, received-only otherwise.
Use compact whole/individual labels (전체/개별), truthful waiting/capture/writing/error states, and remove redundant 미디어 저장 중. Multi-job status must not oscillate or cancel the wrong request.
